description.zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见ListResources接口返回结果中的private_gateway_id字段。
description.en: The ID of the private gateway. You can obtain the ID from the private\_gateway\_id field in the response of the ListResources operation.
The alias of the private gateway.
Specifies whether to enable access over the public network.

description.zh: 网关列表的请求页码，默认为1.
description.en: The page number of the gateway list to return. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的服务数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of gateways to return on each page. The default value is 100.

description.zh: 资源组ID。如何获取资源组，请参见[ListResources](~~412133~~)接口返回结果中的ResourceId字段。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the ID from the ResourceId field in the response of the [ListResources](~~412133~~) operation.
